whatsNew.title: What’s Different in 2026–27
content: Grades 1–12 start six days later this year — September 9 instead of September 3.
Kindergarten starts September 14, six days later than last year. The 2026–27 calendar also specifically includes Transition to Kindergarten.
Winter Break begins December 21, one day earlier than last year, while school still resumes January 4.
The scheduled last day is June 23, compared with June 17 last year. Both are early-release days.
Elementary schools move from trimesters to semesters in 2026–27. Most students will now share the first-semester break day, and elementary students no longer have a separate day off in December.

calendarFaqs.a: No. Students in grades 1–12 start at the regular time on September 9. The weekly one-hour Wednesday late-start schedule begins September 16.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Tacoma conference days no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: The conventional calendar marks October 20 as an elementary early-release day and October 22–23 and March 11–12 as conference early-release days, not full districtwide closures.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the last day of school change if snow make-up days are used?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. June 23 is the scheduled last day, with early release. TPS may use June 24 or 25 as school days if additional make-up time is needed after a closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Do IDEA, SAMI, SOTA, and preschool programs use the conventional TPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. TPS publishes separate calendars for IDEA, SAMI, and SOTA; Head Start and ECEAP; and ECSE specialized preschool. Families should use the calendar for their program when checking attendance and conference dates.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 7, 2026, against the official TPS calendar page, the district's 2026–27 conventional student calendar PDF, and its 2026–27 calendar announcement.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified the separate grades 1–12 and kindergarten/Transition to Kindergarten opening dates, the no-late-start exception on September 9, weekly Wednesday late-start guidance, conference early releases, school closures, major breaks, and the scheduled last day.
November 30 and April 12 are the next scheduled student weekdays after the published Thanksgiving and Spring Break ranges. January 4 is explicitly labeled as the date school resumes for all grades.
Snow make-up dates are conditional. The downloadable calendar does not predict whether TPS will activate them or automatically update after a district announcement.

TPS's 2026–27 calendar announcement confirms that elementary schools are moving from three trimesters to two semesters, with most students sharing the first-semester break day and no separate elementary day off in December.
The official TPS calendar page lists separate IDEA/SAMI/SOTA, Head Start/ECEAP, and ECSE calendars; those program-specific dates are outside this conventional-calendar dataset.
